description: This Java source file defines the LogViewer class, which is part of the rusEfi engine tuning and logging system. It provides a UI component for browsing log files, displaying logs, and integrating with engine state visualization. The class handles folder navigation, log file selection, and initiating log data parsing and visualization.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that provides a UI for browsing, selecting, and viewing log files related to rusEfi engine logs.

methods.name: LogViewer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log viewer UI, sets up folder browsing, file list, and event handlers.

methods.name: refreshCountPanel
methods.description: Updates the display of total charts/graphs based on the ChartRepository size.

methods.name: openFolder
methods.description: Loads and displays log files from the specified folder, automatically opens the most recent log unless it matches the current log name.

methods.name: getFileDesc
methods.description: Creates a FileItem object describing a given log file.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Loads and processes a selected log file, initializing engine state and charts for display.
